name: Stone hammer
description: A heavy rounded stone lashed with rawhide across the end of a wooden haft. It drives nails but has no claw to pull them.
notes: A 130 mm stone across a 300 mm haft, grip on the haft. The stone sticks out either side of the slim haft, so the box is mostly air. It is made by the player rather than found, so it has no spawn tiers.

name: Propane torch
description: A hand torch with a control valve, a grip and a long burner tube. It screws onto a propane cylinder to give a hot open flame.
notes: The torch head 0.42 m long; the carry tote and loose accessories are not drawn. heating is the quality name other drafts use. Drawing fuel from an attached cylinder has no content field yet.

name: Reciprocating saw
description: A cordless saw that drives a straight blade back and forth. It cuts wood and metal fast but roughly.
notes: A D-handle saw over its battery pack with a 150 mm blade fitted, 0.58 m long with the blade. sawing and metal_cutting are names other drafts use. It runs on a battery, which Deadvox tools have no field for yet.

name: Rifle maintenance kit
description: A long zipped nylon bag holding spare barrels, adapters and the wrenches and drivers to fit them to one family of rifles.
notes: A closed bag 600 by 130 by 35 mm with a carry strap and a stencil panel. The name and description name no faction or weapon. repairing 2 is a gunsmith kit's grade; wrenching and screwing are Deadvox's qualities, at kit grade 1. Fine wrench and fine screwdriver grades fold into those.

name: Bronze saw
description: A cast bronze wood saw with a tapering toothed blade and a riveted wooden grip. It blunts faster than steel.
notes: A 0.5 m saw lying flat, grip at -x. No axe quality is carried over, since a saw does not chop. It is smithed by the player, so it has no spawn tiers.

name: Screwdriver set
description: A plastic case of six screwdrivers in several sizes and tip shapes, from a stubby driver to a long thin one.
notes: A 280 mm case opened flat on its hinge, six drivers in the tray. The open lid doubles the footprint. screwing 2, the screwdriver set grade above a multitool or drill. The socket screwdriver set shares the shape and stats. The socket wrench set and the luthier toolset bring wrenching and fine woodworking rather than driving, so they ride on this case only until a socket case and a luthier's roll exist.

name: Firearm repair kit
description: A hard case of gunsmithing tools in a foam tray: a hammer, a file, a small hacksaw, punches and drivers, with a battery pack for the powered bits.
notes: A 320 by 220 mm case drawn open with its lid standing behind, so the tools show. The standing lid adds 0.2 m of height that a closed case would not have. repairing 1 is its main job; the other qualities map to names other drafts use at kit grade 1; fine hammer, fine metal saw, wood chisel and nail prying grades fold into the nearest of these. Each repair uses one battery charge, which Deadvox tools have no field for yet.

name: Soldering iron
description: A pencil iron with a ribbed grip and a copper tip that heats enough to melt solder, for electronics work.
notes: A 220 mm iron lying along x; the mains cord is cut at its strain relief. soldering is a new quality name. The portable variant runs on batteries instead of mains and shares the shape. Power draw has no content field yet.

name: Tap and die set
description: A die stock holding a round die for cutting outside threads, and a tap wrench with a tap for cutting threads inside a hole.
notes: A 400 mm die stock and a 180 mm tap wrench laid side by side. threading is a new quality name covering thread cutting and tapping.

name: Tin snips
description: Heavy shears with short broad jaws for cutting thin sheet metal cleanly. Thick stock needs a saw.
notes: 250 mm snips lying flat, handles spread, grip on one handle. metal_shearing is the name another draft uses; the coarse metal saw grade is left out because snips do not cut thick stock.

name: Toolbox
description: A stout steel box for tools, with a carry handle on its lid and two snap latches at the front.
notes: A 420 by 180 mm box 230 mm tall to the handle, latches on +z. The workshop toolbox rides on this model as the brief asks, but it is much larger and heavier, so drawn at this size it reads small; a larger chest model would suit it. The pocket grid is a placeholder for an 8 L box.

name: Vacuum former
description: A tabletop machine that softens a plastic sheet under a heater, then pulls it down over a mould on a perforated platen.
notes: A 350 mm base with a clamp frame on two columns and a heater hood on top, pump at the back. The frame and heater stand on columns over open air. vacuum_forming is a new quality name. It needs power, which Deadvox tools have no field for yet.

name: Arc welder
description: A portable welding power unit with a current dial and two leads, one to an electrode holder and one to an earth clamp.
notes: A 300 mm unit with its panel on +z and the leads laid out 0.3 m in front. The leads lie out in front, so the box is mostly air. welding is a new quality name. It needs mains power, which Deadvox tools have no field for yet.

name: Makeshift arc welder
description: Two salvaged transformers bolted to a plank and wired together, with a taped mains cord, a wooden electrode holder and a spring clamp.
notes: A 380 by 260 mm plank with two transformers, mains cord off -x and leads laid out on +z. The cord and leads lie out around the plank. It is built by the player, so it has no spawn tiers. welding is shared with the arc welder; its lower efficiency needs a power-draw field that does not exist yet.

name: Welding blanket
description: A heavy fireproof mat for shielding nearby surfaces from weld spatter or wrapping a fresh weld to cool slowly. This one is woven with asbestos.
notes: A 1.8 m blanket folded to 500 by 400 by 60 mm with a hem and brass grommets; canvas-grey stands in for asbestos cloth. It brings no crafting quality of its own; what it protects is left to recipes. Asbestos exposure has no content field yet.
